sources.inventory: All retained public channels, project channels, and relevant direct-message conversations in the synthetic workspace.
All retained project pages and nested blocks, including attachment references.
All retained issues, pull requests, reviews, comments, and releases.

records.author: Contributor 04
records.body: Starting a thread for Project Glassfin. The current conductivity assay worksheet accepts impossible dilution combinations and gives technicians no warning. Contributor 01, Contributor 03, and I will sketch a guarded replacement before the April trial.
records.title: Glassfin kickoff thread

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: I mapped the existing worksheet rules into six validation cases. Two questions remain: whether reruns inherit the original sample temperature and whether a blank result may be released. I put both in the decision page rather than guessing.
records.title: Initial rule mapping

records.author: Contributor 03
records.body: For reruns, technicians record the new temperature. Blank results must stay blocked until a supervisor signs off. I added those decisions to the page.
records.title: Rule decisions

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: The form prototype is ready for a bench walkthrough. I wrote the validation layer and the inline error text; could you check whether the sequence matches how technicians actually prepare the dilution?
records.title: Request for workflow review

records.author: Contributor 02
records.body: Sequence is mostly right. The warning arrives after the technician has already disposed of the aliquot. Move the volume check ahead of the preparation confirmation. I can test again Friday.
records.title: Prototype feedback

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Agreed. I moved that check earlier and added a test for the disposal case. The broader step order came from Contributor 04's process map, not from my interviews.
records.title: Feedback incorporated

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Today's pilot surfaced a unit bug: entering 750 µL was compared as 750 mL and blocked every such dilution. I disabled release of the pilot build and am preparing a conversion fix. Three trial records were affected; none were published.
records.title: Pilot unit defect

records.author: Contributor 04
records.body: Confirmed the three records stayed in the sandbox. Contributor 01 found this during observation, but our review checklist also missed mixed-unit inputs.
records.title: Impact confirmation

records.author: Contributor 03
records.body: Second bench run completed: 18 sample entries, no invalid dilution accepted. Two technicians still paused at the supervisor-signoff wording. This is a limited trial, not a production reliability result.
records.title: Second bench run

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: I drafted the migration script and rollback checklist for moving active assay templates. It deliberately skips archived templates and anything with an unrecognised unit label.
records.title: Migration draft

records.author: Contributor 05
records.body: The dry run skipped 14 active templates because 'microlitre' was stored as free text. That is safer than converting them incorrectly, but operations needs a cleanup path before launch.
records.title: Migration dry-run result

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: I added an alias table for the four verified spellings and left the other ten templates in the exception report. Contributor 05 owns confirming those labels with the assay leads.
records.title: Migration exception handling

records.author: Contributor 06
records.body: Glassfin can enter controlled release on 24 May. Contributor 03 approved the assay rules, Contributor 04 approved the operating procedure, and Contributor 01 has completed the application and migration checks.
records.title: Controlled-release approval

records.author: Contributor 02
records.body: First shift on the new form was quieter than expected. One person needed help finding the rerun control; the other five completed entries without assistance. That is one shift in the pilot laboratory.
records.title: First-shift observation

records.author: Contributor 05
records.body: All 14 migration exceptions are resolved: four aliases were safe, eight labels were corrected manually, and two obsolete templates were retired by their owners. Contributor 01 supplied the report and tooling; assay leads made the content decisions.
records.title: Migration exceptions resolved

records.author: Contributor 07
records.body: In the first four weeks, the pilot laboratory logged 126 assay entries. Seven invalid combinations were blocked before submission. We found no released record with a dilution-rule breach, though manual audit covered only 40 of the 126 entries.
records.title: Four-week quality review

records.author: Contributor 03
records.body: A blank result was released after a supervisor approved it without reading the note. The software enforced signoff as designed; it did not require a reason. We should not describe the control as preventing inappropriate approval.
records.title: Blank-result incident

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: I proposed requiring an approval reason and showing the blank flag in the confirmation. Contributor 03 prefers the visible flag now and wants evidence before making free-text reasons mandatory. I opened the smaller change accordingly.
records.title: Incident response proposal

records.author: Contributor 06
records.body: The second laboratory has postponed adoption until its instrument-interface replacement is complete. Glassfin remains live only in the pilot laboratory; the delay is not currently attributed to the form.
records.title: Expansion postponed

records.author: Contributor 08
records.body: The lunch-order sheet closes at 15:00. Please mark dietary requirements in the separate field rather than the comments column.
records.title: Lunch order

records.author: Contributor 09
records.body: The east bench balance is drifting by roughly 0.03 g. It has been tagged out pending calibration; this is unrelated to the conductivity instruments.
records.title: Balance calibration

records.author: Contributor 06
records.body: The second laboratory completed its interface work and plans a Glassfin readiness review next month. No adoption date has been agreed.
records.title: Later expansion update

records.author: Contributor 04
records.body: Objective: reduce invalid conductivity-assay entries by replacing the shared worksheet with a guarded form. Initial scope is one pilot laboratory. Contributor 04 owns process and rollout; Contributor 03 owns assay-rule approval; Contributor 01 owns form implementation and validation logic; Contributor 05 supports migration.
records.title: Project Glassfin brief

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Draft inventory covering ranges, dilution ratios, units, reruns, blank results, supervisor release, and error wording. Entries marked 'decision needed' are not implemented assumptions.
records.title: Rule inventory draft

records.author: Contributor 03
records.body: Approved: reruns use newly measured temperature; blank results require supervisor signoff; ranges follow assay family rather than instrument model. Assay-rule authority remains with Contributor 03.
records.title: Approved assay decisions

records.author: Contributor 02
records.body: Five technicians attempted the scripted workflow. Four completed without prompting. The early volume warning prevented one unnecessary preparation. The sample is too small to estimate routine error rates.
records.title: Bench walkthrough notes

records.author: Contributor 03
records.body: Eighteen synthetic entries completed. Expected blocks: 6; observed blocks: 6. Unexpected blocks: 0. Signoff wording caused two hesitations. No claim is made about live throughput.
records.title: Trial run 2 results

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Migration sequence: snapshot templates, transform recognised units, produce exception report, obtain owner confirmation, then enable the form. Roll back if record counts differ or any active template disappears.
records.title: Release and rollback runbook

records.author: Contributor 06
records.body: Controlled release approved for the pilot laboratory. Open limitations: help text for reruns is easy to miss; ten template labels still require owner confirmation; monitoring is manual for the first month. Approvals are recorded by functional owner, not by consensus.
records.title: Readiness decision

records.author: Contributor 08
records.body: June watering slots are open. The west planter tap remains stiff, so bring the small valve key from the supply drawer.
records.title: Garden rota note

records.author: Contributor 07
records.body: Scope: pilot laboratory, 24 May–18 June. 126 entries; 7 invalid combinations blocked before submission; 0 dilution-rule breaches among 40 manually audited released entries. These observations do not establish the status of the other 86 released entries or other laboratories.
records.title: Month-one quality review

records.author: Contributor 06
records.body: Pilot laboratory: live. Second laboratory: waiting on instrument-interface replacement. Third laboratory: not assessed. There is no organisation-wide adoption decision.
records.title: Expansion tracker

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Implement validation cases from the rule inventory. Acceptance criteria cover ratio bounds, family-specific ranges, canonical units, rerun temperature, blank-result signoff, and actionable messages. Two policy questions remain linked to the decision log.
records.title: Issue 12: validation cases

records.author: Contributor 03
records.body: Policy questions are resolved in the decision log. Please treat my values as assay requirements, not implementation suggestions.
records.title: Assay requirements confirmed

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Adds the guarded entry form, six validation paths, inline messages, and event logging. Does not migrate existing templates or change assay definitions.
records.title: PR 18: guarded entry form

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Revision moves the volume check before preparation confirmation and adds a regression test for an aliquot that would otherwise be discarded. Change follows Contributor 02's walkthrough feedback.
records.title: PR 18 revision

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Mixed-unit comparison treats microlitres as millilitres in one client-side path. Severity is high for usability, but affected records were sandbox-only. Release disabled pending fix and cross-unit tests.
records.title: Issue 21: mixed-unit comparison

records.author: Contributor 10
records.body: Fix correctly normalises volumes before comparison. I requested a parameterised test across every supported unit pair because the original tests covered only matching units.
records.title: Review of unit fix

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Added the full unit-pair matrix and a server-side check matching the client rule. All 24 combinations pass. Contributor 10 approved after the update.
records.title: Unit fix completed

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Adds dry-run migration, rollback verification, and an exception report. The transformer refuses unknown unit labels rather than coercing them.
records.title: PR 31: template migration tooling

records.author: Contributor 05
records.body: Dry run: 73 active templates discovered; 59 convertible; 14 skipped for free-text unit labels. Counts reconcile and no source templates were modified.
records.title: Migration dry-run review

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Adds a reviewed alias table and exports unresolved labels for owner action. It does not decide whether a label is scientifically equivalent; those decisions remain outside the code.
records.title: PR 34: unit aliases and exceptions

records.author: Contributor 10
records.body: Approved. The alias list matches the four labels confirmed by Contributor 05. Keeping the other ten out of automatic conversion is the safer boundary.
records.title: Alias review approval

records.author: Contributor 06
records.body: Controlled release to the pilot laboratory. Included: guarded entry form, validation logging, reviewed unit conversion, exception reporting, and rollback procedure. Expansion requires a separate readiness decision.
records.title: Glassfin 1.0 controlled release

records.author: Contributor 09
records.body: Notebook PDF export wraps long reagent names over the footer. This repository is separate from Glassfin; scheduling for the next maintenance cycle.
records.title: Unrelated PDF export defect

records.author: Contributor 03
records.body: A supervisor released a blank result after completing the required signoff. The configured rule worked, but the confirmation did not foreground the blank status. Decide whether to strengthen display, require rationale, or change procedure.
records.title: Issue 47: blank approval control

records.author: Contributor 01
records.body: Foregrounds the blank flag in the approval confirmation and adds an acknowledgement checkbox. A mandatory written rationale is excluded pending policy evidence. Contributor 03 supplied the accepted wording.
records.title: PR 49: clearer blank confirmation

records.author: Contributor 07
records.body: Approved after accessibility checks. This improves salience but cannot establish that supervisors make appropriate decisions; monitor approvals separately.
records.title: Blank-confirmation review

attachments.title: Month-one audit sample export
attachments.body: Synthetic audit extract listing 40 reviewed record identifiers, reviewer outcomes, and no observed dilution-rule breaches. It contains no evidence about the remaining 86 entries.
